behavior: dotf harness resolve-tier top --harness claude prints opus on stdout and exits 0
verification: cd cli && out=$(go test ./internal/cmd/ -run '^TestHarnessResolveTier$' -v 2>&1) && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestHarnessResolveTier/the_tier_the_only_deployed_agent_declares '

behavior: A tier a harness does not declare exits non-zero, names the tier and the harness, and writes nothing to stdout
verification: cd cli && out=$(go test ./internal/cmd/ -run '^TestHarnessResolveTier$' -v 2>&1) && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestHarnessResolveTier/a_declared_harness_that_no_tier_declares '

behavior: An absent, unschema'd, schema-invalid or non-JSON model-map fails rather than resolving to a default (C15)
verification: cd cli && out=$(go test ./internal/cmd/ -run '^TestHarnessResolveTierFailsLoudWithoutAMap$' -v 2>&1) && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestHarnessResolveTierFailsLoudWithoutAMap/a_map_the_schema_rejects '

behavior: A record declaring model: top deploys as model: opus, and the neutral tier never reaches the rendered file
verification: out=$(bats tests/compile-harness.bats -f 'resolves the neutral model tier into the rendered frontmatter' 2>&1) && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qE '^ok [0-9]+ .*resolves the neutral model tier into the rendered frontmatter$'

behavior: An unresolvable tier fails the deploy and leaves the previous agent definition intact rather than truncating it
verification: out=$(bats tests/compile-harness.bats -f 'an unresolvable tier leaves the PREVIOUS agent definition intact' 2>&1) && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qE '^ok [0-9]+ .*leaves the PREVIOUS agent definition intact$'

behavior: An absent dotf warns and renders without a model line instead of failing the harness deploy
verification: out=$(bats tests/compile-harness.bats -f 'an absent dotf warns and renders without a model line' 2>&1) && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qE '^ok [0-9]+ .*it does not fail the deploy$'

behavior: A dotf too old to know resolve-tier warns rather than embedding its help output as the model id
verification: out=$(bats tests/compile-harness.bats -f 'a dotf too old to know resolve-tier' 2>&1) && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qE '^ok [0-9]+ .*rather than embedding its help output$'

behavior: The resolver's own diagnosis reaches the deploy output, so a schema-invalid map is not misreported as a tier problem
verification: out=$(bats tests/compile-harness.bats -f "the resolver's own diagnosis reaches the deploy output" 2>&1) && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qE '^ok [0-9]+ .*not just a generic tier error$'

behavior: Skill deploy still completes when the agent render fails
verification: out=$(bats tests/compile-harness.bats -f 'skill deploy survives a failed agent render' 2>&1) && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qE '^ok [0-9]+ .*skill deploy survives a failed agent render$'

behavior: kind, capabilities, skills and targets are still dropped from the rendered frontmatter; only model changed
verification: out=$(bats tests/compile-harness.bats -f 'renders agent-md' 2>&1) && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qE '^ok [0-9]+ .*neutral keys dropped\)$'

behavior: The real dotf binary, not a stub, satisfies the capability probe and the stdout contract the render depends on
verification: out=$(bats tests/compile-harness-real.bats 2>&1) && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qE '^ok [0-9]+ real dotf: a full deploy renders the resolved model id into the agent file$'

behavior: The Claude settings merge policy names every dotfiles-owned scalar key on both platforms, so a template key is never a silent no-op
verification: out=$(bats tests/claude-settings-template.bats -f 'named in both merge policies' 2>&1) && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qE '^ok [0-9]+ .*named in both merge policies$'
